title: Double: arrays vs slices
hints: All three functions use the same loop: `for i := range x { x[i] *= 2 }`. The difference is only *whose* elements get changed.
`a *Quad` can be indexed and ranged directly: `a[i]` means `(*a)[i]`. Guard with `if a == nil { return }` first.
In `Doubled`, the parameter `a` is already a fresh copy of the caller's array: double its elements and `return a`.
